release_parity.explanation: The archived baseline has no .git, so initial Sentry autodetection omitted a 206-byte raw release wrapper per chunk. Baseline was rebuilt with explicit SENTRY_RELEASE matching the frozen feature. Only the corrected browser baseline is compared.

environment.network: Local HTTPS app on identical origin/port. Browser image GETs remain live; local read proxies serve Crate and Qdrant. Successful identical Crate queries reuse cached responses; this is not a full immutable backend snapshot.

safety.browser: Puppeteer request interception installed before Lighthouse navigation. Only GET/HEAD to local app or HTTPS image.tmdb.org allowed; demand and telemetry sinks fulfilled locally. Service workers bypassed.
safety.app: Child socket preload rejects all non-loopback connections. Only local read proxies can reach backends; no database mutation is forwarded.
safety.crate: Only SELECT/WITH queries without DML/DDL or multiple statements, and GET blob objects. Final matched stages recorded zero mutating SQL requests.
safety.qdrant: Exact gRPC read-method allowlist and REST read-route allowlist. Synthetic DELETE preflight returned403 locally. No write RPC is forwarded.
safety.build_stage_caveat: The first corrected baseline npm build omitted the Node socket preload. Existing Sentry Vite plugin logs reported sending bundler telemetry twice, so build telemetry may have been emitted. No delivery proof is available. Auth token was unset and plugin reported no source-map uploads. No production database write occurred. Runtime/browser benchmark traffic remained guarded. This gap was corrected and the baseline build was repeated successfully with non-loopback sockets denied.

guarded_rebuild.note: All75 distinct requested content-hashed client script filenames and raw byte lengths remained unchanged after the guarded rebuild; no Lighthouse rerun was needed.

limits: One sample per surface establishes payload/request comparison, not statistical timing significance. CPU benchmark readings retained per page. Other users processes were not stopped.
All timing/score limits passed on both builds; small timing deltas are not claimed as a performance improvement.
Old feature report had61 failed home images; preliminary no-release and Qdrant-disabled baselines are excluded. Matched corrected runs have equal image counts per surface.
Raw Lighthouse reports remain under ignored benchmark results; this artifact retains measured metrics, failure labels, exact report hashes, setup and harness sources for reproduction.

reproduction.baseline_build_command: cd /tmp/gw-opened-baseline/goodwatch-webapp && env -u SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN -u SENTRY_ORG -u SENTRY_PROJECT NODE_OPTIONS='--require /tmp/gw-streaming-perf-deny.cjs' SENTRY_RELEASE=a9f4cf06cd51aa73cf5e6bec6ad8eab7389751f2 SHARP_IGNORE_GLOBAL_LIBVIPS=1 npm run build
reproduction.setup: Restore the four harness source strings below to /tmp with the same filenames. Update checkout/cache paths if needed. Both builds use the same isolated node_modules; the archived baseline symlink targets the implementation checkout dependency installation. Use the prior local TLS certificate/key or create a local-only certificate. Read existing local service settings without printing credentials. Seed the six-surface URL file via the standard budget URL generator; keep the share-list path private. The harness runs only local app instances, never deploys and forwards only backend reads.
